what: Estimation of the variance for a relative difference
title: confidence_intervals_derivation
text: relative difference estimates delta method approach can extended account non-linear function ratio two random variables applied calculating relative difference .e. variance estimates form Var(Y−XY)=Var(1−XY)=Var(XY). \text{Var}\left(\frac{Y - X}{Y}\right) = \text{Var}\left(1 - \frac{X}{Y}\right) = \text{Var}\left(\frac{X}{Y}\right). Define ratio function f(x,y)=x/yf(x,y) = x/y. Performing second order Taylor expansion around mean XX YY provides following approaximation, f(x,y)≈f(x‾,y‾)+fx′(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)+fy′(x‾,y‾)(y−y‾)+12[fxx″(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)2+fxy″(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)(y−y‾)+fyy″(x‾,y‾)(y−y‾)2]. \begin{aligned} f(x,y) &\approx f(\bar{x},\bar{y}) + f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x}) + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})(y - \bar{y}) \\ &+ \frac{1}{2} \left[ f''_{xx}(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x})^2  + f''_{xy}(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x})(y - \bar{y}) + f''_{yy}(\bar{x},\bar{y})(y - \bar{y})^2 \right]. \end{aligned} estimation variance can take first order approximation given definition, Var(f(X,Y))=𝔼[(f(X,Y)−f(x‾,y‾))2]\text{Var}(f(X,Y)) = \mathbb{E}\left[ (f(X,Y) - f(\bar{x},\bar{y}))^2 \right] use approximation 𝔼[f(X,Y)]=f(x‾,y‾)\mathbb{E}[f(X,Y)] = f(\bar{x},\bar{y}). Applying first order Taylor approximation variance gives, Var(f(X,Y))=𝔼[(f(X,Y)−f(x‾,y‾))2]=𝔼[(f(x‾,y‾)+fx′(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)+fy′(x‾,y‾)(y−y‾)−f(x‾,y‾))2]=𝔼[(fx′(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)+fy′(x‾,y‾)(y−y‾))2]=𝔼[fx′(x‾,y‾)2(x−x‾)2+fy′(x‾,y‾)2(y−y‾)2+fx′(x‾,y‾)fy′(x‾,y‾)(x−x‾)(y−y‾)]=fx′(x‾,y‾)2Var(X)+fy′(x‾,y‾)2Var(Y)+fx′(x‾,y‾)fy′(x‾,y‾)Cov(X,Y) \begin{aligned} \text{Var}(f(X,Y)) &= \mathbb{E}\left[ (f(X,Y) - f(\bar{x},\bar{y}))^2 \right] \\  &= \mathbb{E}\left[ \left(f(\bar{x},\bar{y}) + f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x}) + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})(y - \bar{y}) - f(\bar{x},\bar{y}) \right)^2 \right] \\ &= \mathbb{E}\left[ \left(f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x}) + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})(y - \bar{y}) \right)^2 \right] \\ &= \mathbb{E}\left[ f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2(x - \bar{x})^2 + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2(y - \bar{y})^2 +   f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})(x - \bar{x})(y - \bar{y})\right] \\ &= f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2 \text{Var}(X) + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2 \text{Var}(Y) + f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y}) \text{Cov}(X,Y) \end{aligned} Given fx′(x‾,y‾)=1/y‾f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y}) = 1/\bar{y} fy′(x‾,y‾)=−x‾/y‾2f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y}) = -\bar{x}/\bar{y}^2 arrive final result, Var(f(X,Y))=fx′(x‾,y‾)2Var(X)+fy′(x‾,y‾)2Var(Y)+fx′(x‾,y‾)fy′(x‾,y‾)Cov(X,Y)=1/y‾2Var(X)+x‾2/y‾4Var(Y)−x‾/y‾3Cov(X,Y)=1/y‾4(y‾2Var(X)+x‾2Var(Y)−x‾y‾Cov(X,Y)) \begin{aligned} \text{Var}(f(X,Y)) &= f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2 \text{Var}(X) + f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y})^2 \text{Var}(Y) + f'_x(\bar{x},\bar{y})f'_y(\bar{x},\bar{y}) \text{Cov}(X,Y) \\ &= 1/\bar{y}^2 \text{Var}(X)  + \bar{x}^2/\bar{y}^4 \text{Var}(Y) -\bar{x}/\bar{y}^3 \text{Cov}(X,Y) \\ &= 1/\bar{y}^4 \left( \bar{y}^2\text{Var}(X)  + \bar{x}^2 \text{Var}(Y) -\bar{x}\bar{y} \text{Cov}(X,Y)  \right) \end{aligned}
